headline: USD0 token proxy confirmed on Ethereum (0x73a15fed); 12+ audit reports spanning May 2024–Nov 2025; deployed-contracts doc and full admin address set not yet fetched
short_headline: USD0 proxy found; full address set pending

findings.text: D1: Etherscan search for 'usual.money USD0 deployed contracts addresses Ethereum' returned the USD0 token proxy at 0x73a15fed60bf67631dc6cd7bc5b6e8da8190acf5 (EIP-1967 Transparent Proxy) with implementation at 0xae12f6f805842e6dafe71a6d2b41b28ba5fc821e; prior implementation noted at 0xa17f4646d1a693446dd8c749ff38bf7c2a21c98e. No additional Etherscan name-tag search was completable due to fetch-limit constraints; remaining addresses (bUSD0, USUAL, USUALx, treasury, registry, etc.) not surfaced from explorer in this run.

D2: docs.usual.money/developers/smart-contracts was attempted but rejected by the fetch allowlist (URL had not appeared in prior fetch results). A deployed-contracts doc URL was not confirmed in this run; flagged as unknown for next run.

D3: tech.usual.money/security-and-audits/audits fetched successfully. 12+ audits spanning May 2024 through November 2025 identified across Cantina/Spearbit, Halborn, Sherlock, Paladin, Blackthorne, Hexens, OAK Security. Scope includes USD0 (permissioned/permissionless launch), bUSD0 (formerly USD0++), USUAL, USUALx, SwapperEngine, DAO Collateral, WrappedM (UsualM), UsualUSDtb, Euler USL vault/oracle, Yield Module, Claim Redirect, Fee Sweep/DistributionModule, bUSD0 Investment Vault, ETH0 Protocol/Zapper, USUALX Lockup, sUSD0, sEUR0, RDM, USD0a, EUR0. Audit PDFs are embedded as GitBook file attachments and were not directly fetchable as external PDFs; no in-scope addresses extracted from audit files.

D4: GitHub org https://github.com/usual-dao confirmed with 6 repositories visible (yield-server, DefiLlama-Adapters, dimension-adapters, paraswap-dex-lib, pendle-generic-balance-fetcher, kyberswap-dex-lib) — all forks/adapters with no protocol contract deployment artifacts. No core contracts repo (e.g. usual-dao/pegasus or usual-dao/contracts) was discoverable as public in this run. No deployment JSON or broadcast artifacts extracted.

D5: Protocol.chains = Ethereum only. No multi-chain enumeration required. Note: website mentions '4 Supported Chains' and references LayerZero/OFT adapter (audited by Paladin Oct 2024 for L2 Token contracts + OFT MintAndBurnAdapter + L1 OFT Adapter), suggesting L2 deployments exist but are not in scope for this Ethereum-only run.
D6: No factory contract addresses were surfaced in D1–D4; factory enumeration not performable in this run.

D7: USD0 proxy classified as token (role=token, actor_class=unknown pending on-chain read). Implementation and prior implementation addresses recorded with role=other (audit-era) pending re-verification.

D8: All three addresses traced to the Etherscan search result snippet (search result index 3). USD0 proxy 0x73a15fed confirmed; implementation 0xae12f6f8 and prior implementation 0xa17f4646 recorded as snippet-only sightings — added to unknowns per D8 rule until an on-chain fetch confirms them.

rationale.verdict: One corpora walked (official audit page + website) and one search query returned one on-chain address; GitHub org found but no public contract repo; docs deployed-contracts page unreachable from fetch allowlist. Total: 1 confirmed address (USD0 proxy), 2 snippet-only addresses (implementation, prior implementation), 0 admin/multisig/timelock addresses catalogued.

evidence.shows: Official protocol website confirming products (USD0 stablecoin, bUSD0 liquid staking, USUAL governance token), audit firms (Paladin, Halborn, Spearbit, Cantina, Sherlock), governance via Snapshot at usualmoney.eth, docs at docs.usual.money, bug bounty at tech.usual.money/security-and-audits/bug-bounty, security contact security@usual.company

Security contact: security@usual.company

protocol_metadata.about: Usual is a decentralized RWA stablecoin protocol on Ethereum that allows users to mint USD0, a 1:1 dollar-pegged stablecoin fully collateralized by tokenized US Treasury Bill assets (USYC, M0, USDtb). Users can stake USD0 into bUSD0 (formerly USD0++), a liquid yield-bearing position with a 4-year lock-up structure that earns T-Bill yield. The protocol's governance token USUAL is distributed to liquidity providers and stakers, giving them ownership of protocol revenues; USUALx is the staked form of USUAL that receives a share of protocol fees.
